1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 2 moving lofts; 104px planks; 0 elevation changes; coupling 0.0. Gust force 190, span 4200 ms.
1.natural_language: Carry the lantern across drifting stairwalks to the beacon. Shift the lofts with their winches, walk along the stairs, and steer through each moving connection. Green planks enter a loft; gold planks leave it. Heights must meet. Wind and rope forces advance in fixed 240 ms action quanta during crossing and dragging; idle time does not move the lofts. A fall or END / CERTIFY before delivery ends the episode; later attempts cannot earn a pass. Inspection, winch edits, blocked movement and unplanked Cross feedback remain available.

full.summary: Drag a winch handle to a detent; hold arrow keys to steer; Space walks across the forward plank.

simplified.summary: Click equivalent winch detents; hold visible walk buttons; click Cross. No auto-aim or automatic alignment.

non_real_time_timing.held_input: Each trusted walk press or drag update samples one fixed action quantum; release stops future quanta and does not advance the world.
